messages:
alex_chan (AE): Hey team — running a presales sync for GreenWave. They want enterprise commit sizing & SLA details. Target: sustained 1k RPS text-gen (avg 30 tokens) with 95th tail latency <= 350ms. Also flagged CCPA + KMS requirements. Can we map to reserved GPU plan + autoscale policy?
marie_devrel: Thx Alex. Quick q: traffic shape? steady 1k or spiky bursts? any peak multipliers?
samir_infra: From prelim: baseline 1k RPS steady during business hours, 3x spikes for 10-15m windows. Token lengths usually short (10-50) but there are occasional 400-token backfills.
jess_prod: For 95th 350ms we need reserved capacity + prewarm. If we use A100-like instance equivalent, estimate ~12-16 GPUs for sustained + headroom. Burst credits or spot pool for spikes.
alex_chan (AE): Customer asked for hard guarantees on latency for SLAs — can we propose a tiered plan: reserved for baseline, burst credits + autoscale for spikes? They want explicit preheat/runbook for KV warmup.
samir_infra: Recommend: reserved pool 14 GPUs (zone spread), autoscale policy: burst up to +6 GPUs with preheat slots, and an admission control throttle to keep tail latency. Also set policy to fall back to smaller quantized model if latency breaches. Sample autoscale config:
```
autoscale_policy:
  baseline_gpus: 14
  burst_limit: 6
  preheat_window: 120s
  cooldown: 300s
  latency_slo_95: 350ms
  fallback_variant: model-v2-quantized
```
marie_devrel: Nice. Add KV cache pre-warm steps in onboarding: staged rollout -> canary -> full. Document `KV_WARMUP_KEYS` checklist.
jess_prod: Also add prefix caching for sessions to shave 20-40ms on many queries. For long backfill batches, route to dedicated batch workers to avoid tail impact.
olivia_secu: CCPA note: they require data residency + ability to delete logs on request. For private commit we need VPC + customer KMS/HSM integration and audit logs retained 1y. Need answers for questionnaire Q12-Q18 about key rotation and export controls.
alex_chan (AE): Got it. Can we provide a short blurb for the security questionnaire and call out KMS options?
olivia_secu: I'll draft. Short answer: "Supports customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) with HSM-backed rotation. Audit logs retained, deletion API available, data plane isolation via VPC/private deployment." Will attach SOC/ISO links.
samir_infra: Operational notes: recommend app-level circuit breaker with rate limiter and token-bucket to avoid cascading overload during spikes. Also we should provision headroom for AZ failover — reserve 10% extra GPUs across another AZ.
jess_prod: Pricing note for sales: reserved 14 GPUs + 6-burst cushion => present as "14 reserved + 6 burst credits" with preheat add-on. Include cost delta if they want 24/7 prewarm.
alex_chan (AE): Customer asked about fallback quality when we switch to quantized variant. Can we share eval delta for their prompts?
marie_devrel: We can run a quick eval on their sample prompt set. Offer: run 500-sample quality check, show token-level cost and BLEU/whatever. Will take ~48h.
alex_chan (AE): Perfect. Any blockers? timeline?
olivia_secu: Need to confirm legal on CCPA deletion SLA (24-72h). Also need their DPA signature.
samir_infra: Techwise no blockers — just confirm committed GPUs and whether they accept cross-AZ reservation.
deploy-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/presales-reservation-playbook — includes preheat steps, KV warmup checklist, and autoscale templates. :link: :rocket:
alex_chan (AE): Action items: 1) I will send draft proposal with 14R+6B pricing and SLA language (today). 2) Marie will run 500-sample eval (48h). 3) Olivia will draft security responses (EOD). 4) Samir will prepare autoscale config + AZ headroom note.
marie_devrel: I'll queue eval. Will ping when complete.
samir_infra: Preparing config + runbook tweaks now.
olivia_secu: Drafting sec answers, will attach SOC/ISO links and KMS template.
alex_chan (AE): Thanks all — will update GreenWave after we have the eval results and security appendix. :thumbsup:
